property.statement: For an otherwise identical graph with a discovery ref and a none-strength edge, candidate and absent evidence states must not reach the observed classifier or produce modular decomposition.
property.observed_control: The same fixture in observed state classifies as modular; its receipt limits whole-design authority to shadow-governed-only.
negative_controls: The test copies the graph with only evidence_state changed to candidate and asserts entangled, defaulted_to_more_coupling, blocked, and system_evidence_required decomposition.
The same graph with evidence_state absent remains entangled, defaulted_to_more_coupling, and blocked.
property.proxy_divergence: The intended evidence predicate is that a graph is genuinely observed. The code checks the caller-supplied evidence_state plus reference/edge presence. A graph with unresolved or fabricated module_discovery_ref and edge evidence_ref but evidence_state='observed' is a source-visible divergent case that can enter observed classification; this falsifier was not executed and is not a provenance pass.

capability_state_or_finding_state: GO_bounded for the candidate/absent state selector and its classification/decomposition effect. Provenance of an observed coupling graph is not established. No E02 finding closure is claimed.
limitations_and_next_owner: The observed evidence-state field is caller-supplied. classify_coupling checks its value, module_discovery_ref presence, and edge presence but does not resolve or content-bind module_discovery_ref or ordinary edge evidence_ref.
The classifier's optional independence_consistency_ref can be resolved for a none-strength edge when supplied; that does not authenticate the evidence_state or ordinary edge refs.

The positive test is a fixture-level classification/decomposition control. It does not exercise compose_subdesigns as a persisted producer-to-authority consumer path. The modular receipt remains shadow-governed-only.
This review concerns P17 coupling classification only. It provides no B23 physical-cache or B26 cubic-interaction evidence and does not close B15 child production.
